prerequisites: Ability to calculate internal forces or section forces for statically determinate frame and truss structures.
Knowledge of the basic concepts of continuum mechanics, in particular the concepts of stress and strain.
Ability to determine stresses and deformations across cross-sections for each type of internal force (normal force, shear force, bending moment, and torsion moment).
Ability to calculate displacements in structures based on given internal force diagrams using the principle of virtual work.

learning_outcomes.text: The student can analyze simple hyperstatic structures (determine internal forces, calculate displacements) using both a force method and displacement methods.
The student gains insight into the modeling process, i.e., decisions made when creating a centerline model for a frame or truss structure.
The student is able to sketch a moment diagram without detailed analysis and is able to sketch the displacements of the structure based on this moment diagram.
The student is able to determine influence lines for force and displacement quantities for both statically determinate and indeterminate structures.

syllabus_topics: Method of internal work (a force method)
Modeling aspects of structures (transition from actual structure to computational model, interpretation of results, internal force diagrams, and displacements)
Determination of influence lines for statically determinate and indeterminate structures
Force method, analysis of structures with degree of static indeterminacy of one and more
Rotation method, identifying unknown nodal displacements and formulating the system of equations
Cross method, determining the distribution of moments in the nodes for structures without and with sway
assessment_rules: The exam consists of assignments (exercises, limited theory question) to assess insight into the subject matter. Students are allowed to use a formularium and a calculator during the exam.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
